coordinated_activities.activity: Working a night shift as an aged-care support worker at the residential care facility, assisting residents with overnight care and documentation
Commuting home from the night shift by train and bus
Unpacking work bag, making a light flexitarian breakfast and a cup of tea while checking written reminders on his phone; having breakfast alongside Member 3
Quick shower and wash-up after the night shift, timed to finish before Member 5's 07:30 bathroom slot
Setting an alarm and a written reminder for the afternoon, closing the curtains and turning on the fan to wind down before day sleep
Sleeping after the night shift in a quiet, darkened room
Eating a late flexitarian lunch and drinking tea while reading over notes; having a late lunch with Member 2 who is also eating her leftover-food lunch
Studying Master of Social Work coursework at the desk, reading set texts and typing detailed notes on the computer
Making a cup of tea and a small snack while Member 5 cooks a simple early dinner
Attending an online tutorial for his social work coursework on the computer and monitor
Putting on a load of laundry in the washing machine and tidying up
Cooking and eating a flexitarian dinner using the induction cooker, with no alcohol; having dinner with Member 3 and Member 4
Washing up and loading the dishwasher, wiping down the bench, sharing the kitchen tidy-up with Member 4
Writing a detailed to-do list and setting phone reminders for his rotating shift roster and assignment deadlines
Checking his weekly budget on paper, counting cash for the week and reviewing upcoming rent and bills
Quiet leisure at the desk: looking at the photo of his family dog in China and reading
Evening wash and brushing teeth, and moving laundry to the dryer
Drinking herbal tea and preparing his overnight bag, lunch and snacks for tomorrow's shift, while Member 6 batch-cooks low-carb meals
Winding down with the light dimmed and the fan on, then sleeping
